transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because I’ve barely been wanting to eat lately. Like, at work on my lunch break, I’ll get food I used to like and just sit there staring at it, and then I end up throwing most of it away. It’s been bothering me.
How long have you been experiencing this lack of interest in eating?
About two months now, I think. It started around when I got that window display award and the district manager was giving me all that attention.
Have you lost any weight over these past two months?

I’m not totally sure how much, I haven’t really been checking the scale. But I’m eating a lot less. Most days at lunch I’ll just stare at the food and end up tossing most of it, even stuff I used to like.
Have you noticed your clothes fitting differently over the past two months?

I haven’t really paid attention to my clothes, honestly. I just know I’m barely eating anymore. Like at lunch, I’ll have food I used to like in front of me and I just sit there staring at it, then throw most of it away.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight over the past two months?

I don’t know if it’s a significant amount. I just know I barely want to eat anymore. Like at work, I’ll sit there on lunch with food I used to like, and I end up just staring at it and throwing most of it away.
Do you think you've lost more than 5% of your original body weight over these past two months?

I don’t really know the percentage. I haven’t been tracking my weight like that. I just know I barely want to eat, and on my lunch break I’ll sit there with food I used to like and end up throwing most of it away.
Are you worried about gaining weight?
No, not really. I’m not trying to lose weight or avoid gaining it. I just don’t have much appetite.
Do you think your body is the right shape and size?
I mean… I think it’s fine. I haven’t really been focused on my body shape or size. That’s not what’s been bothering me.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?
No. I’m not scared of gaining weight. It’s more that I just don’t want to eat. Like at work, I’ll be on lunch staring at food I used to like, and I end up throwing most of it away.
Do you feel anxious when you think about eating?
Not really anxious, no. It’s more like I just barely want to eat. I’ll sit there on my lunch break at the store with food I used to like, and I just stare at it… then end up throwing most of it away.
Do you feel uncomfortable when you think about eating in front of other people?
No, I don’t think it’s about other people watching me eat. I haven’t really noticed feeling uncomfortable with that. It’s more just… I don’t feel like eating much.
Do you think eating will have a negative effect on your body?

No, I don’t really think it’s going to do something bad to my body. It’s just that I barely want to eat anymore. Like on my lunch break at the store, I’ll look at food I used to like and just… end up throwing most of it away.
Do you think there's anything emotionally bothering you when you're about to eat?

I don’t know if it’s something emotional right before I eat. It’s just… I barely want it. I’ll be at work on my lunch break with food I used to like, and I just sit there looking at it, then I end up throwing most of it away. That’s kind of what made me think I needed help.
Have you noticed any change in your weight since you started eating less?

I haven’t really been tracking my weight, so I don’t know for sure. I just know I’m eating a lot less. Like at lunch at the store, I’ll get food I used to like and just sit there staring at it, then throw most of it away. That’s what made me think I needed help.
Have you noticed any change in how your clothes fit you since you started eating less?
I haven’t really noticed my clothes fitting different, no. I just know I’m barely eating now. Like at lunch at the store, I’ll sit there with food I used to like and end up throwing most of it away.
Has a friend or family member commented on your weight loss?

No, nobody’s really said anything about my weight. It’s more that I’ve noticed I barely want to eat anymore. I’ll be on lunch at the store with food I used to like, and I just sit there staring at it, then end up throwing most of it away.
Has your lack of interest in eating led to a noticeable weight loss?

I don’t know if it’s led to noticeable weight loss, honestly. I haven’t really checked. What I do know is I barely want to eat anymore. Like on my lunch break at the store, I’ll just stare at food I used to like and end up throwing most of it away.
Has your lack of appetite led to a weight loss that you would consider significant?

I’m not sure if I’d call the weight loss significant, because I haven’t really checked. But the appetite part is bad enough that it made me ask for help. I’ll be at lunch at the store, just staring at food I used to like, and then I end up throwing most of it away.
Do you look thinner to yourself now compared to two months ago?

I’m not really sure if I look thinner. I haven’t been checking like that. What I do notice is I just barely want to eat anymore—like at lunch at the store, I’ll have food I used to like and I just sit there looking at it, then end up throwing most of it away.
Has someone else noticed that you've lost weight?

I don’t think anyone’s said anything to me about losing weight. What made me notice something was wrong is just that I barely want to eat anymore. Like at lunch at the store, I’ll sit there with food I used to like, stare at it, and then throw most of it away.
